name: format_tokens millions - agent: Aider
description: The same task and the same verifier as the other format_tokens scenarios, so the only variable between their report cards is the agent. Aider is a headless one-shot edit: it takes the task, produces edit blocks, and exits.
setup: pip install --quiet --no-input pytest oslex rich packaging
task:
In aider/utils.py, extend the format_tokens(count) function so that counts of one million or more are rendered with an 'M' suffix.

Follow the same shape as the existing thousands logic: below ten million, show one decimal place (for example, 2500000 becomes "2.5M"); at ten million and above, show a rounded whole number (for example, 25400000 becomes "25M").

Counts below one million must keep exactly the formatting they have today - do not change that behaviour.

Do not modify any other function.
